frame_metadata.gps_note: Every frame carries capture time with a -04:00 offset and the F0 build's 9-key GPS block. But from the first label (f0004, 16:18) to the exterior (f0028, 16:33) every frame carries the same fix, taken at 16:16:20 by the entrance: the phone produced no new fix indoors. The fix places the take at Cooper Hewitt; it says nothing about where in the building a frame was shot.

differ.credit_line_for_the_drawing: the label's one credit line covers both, but the catalog credits the drawing 1992-131-8 'Gift of Constantin Boym' — only the vase was bought through the McNeil bequest. A reader that attaches the line's credit to every number on it is wrong for the drawing.
differ.designer_nationality: label 'American, b. Russia, 1955', catalog 'Russian, active USA, b. 1955' — the same facts with different emphasis

traps.confirmed_the_wrong_object: The tester confirmed the first number offered, 1992-131-8, which is the drawing. The photographed object is the vase, 1992-132-1-a,b. Both are on the card, so the confirmation was not wrong about the label — it was wrong about the work. The read-back asks 'is this the number?', not 'is this the number of what you photographed?'.
traps.part_designator: On the device the vase was offered as '1992-132-1' — the '-a,b' dropped. The locator now keeps it, and ranks it first because the longer token scores higher.
traps.bare_number_on_wall_text: The extended label (f0027) ends with a pictogram and '133' — a guide or stop number, not an accession.
